experiment: EXPERIMENT (switchable): THE MANAGER. At the start of every race and tile round one random player is named THE MANAGER (a banner, a clipboard over their head). Every 60-75 s (the show's event gate, 15 s between interrupting events) a compact strip at the bottom edge asks the manager (auto-pick after 3 s) to issue a RULE (3 random choices: keys 1 2 3, E or a pad's item button picks a random one, three buttons on a phone); the rule applies to everybody else for 10-15 s. Alone, the rule hits you after a short delay. Delete this file or set "on" to false and every round plays without it. Rules: modes/show/shared/manager/manager_rules.gd, docs/party-show.md 'The manager (experiment)'.
